An app helper taking a contributed global's name wins as an ordinary
function, and nothing request-scoped is left to build, so the set
loads without a globals option.
-- go.mod --
module app

go 1.26

require (
	github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router v0.0.0
	github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/templates v0.0.0
	github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web v0.0.0
)

replace (
	github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router => ROUTERDIR
	github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/templates => TEMPLATEDIR
	github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web => WEBDIR
)
-- main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- shared/templates.go --
package shared

import "embed"

//fabrik:templates
//go:embed all:templates
var Templates embed.FS

//fabrik:templates:func name=request
func StaticRequest() string { return "none" }
-- shared/templates/_default/_layout.html --
<html>{{ request }}{{ block "content" . }}{{ end }}</html>
-- shared/templates/_default/home.html --
{{ define "content" }}home{{ end }}
-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/templates"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"
)

type Page struct{ Title string }

func (Page) Template() string { return "home" }

type Handlers struct {
	Templates *templates.Set
}

//fabrik:web GET /
func (h *Handlers) Home(req *web.Request) (web.Response, error) {
	return web.View(Page{Title: "home"}), nil
}
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/templates"
	web2 "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"

	"app/shared"
	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		sharedTemplates, err := templates.Load(shared.Templates, "templates", templates.Funcs(templates.FuncMap{
			"request": shared.StaticRequest,
		}))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		webHandlers := &web.Handlers{
			Templates: sharedTemplates,
		}
		adapter := web2.NewAdapter(web2.WithRenderer(sharedTemplates))

		r := router.New()

		// Register
		r.Method("GET", "/", adapter.Wrap(webHandlers.Home))
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
